new.text: 7.2.7.2 Custom service and function profile 1 (KeyM and certificate manage- ment) This profile defines how to use a custom service with the certificate management ser- vices specified for the KeyM. Using this profile enables the KeyM to forward the actual certificate processing to the Crypto Driver and its associated HSM. The Crypto profile provides a consistent mapping of the parameters from the KeyM services and functions to the Csm job configured for the custom service and to the custom synchronous API function Crypto_CustomSync. The ServiceInfoType is defined as CUSTOM_SERVICE with value 0x15. The Crypto_AlgorithmFamilyType is defined as CRYPTO_ALGOFAM_KEYM with value 0x80 and need to be configured via [ECUC_Crypto_00047] CryptoPrimitiveAl- gorithmFamilyCustomId. The Crypto_AlgorithmModeType is defined as CRYPTO_ALGOMODE_NOT_SET with value 0x00. The KeyM_ServiceCertificate (ServiceId: 0x09) can be mapped by the KeyM to call KeyM_ServiceCertificateByCertId (ServiceId: 0x13). In case the data type mapped to a parameter of type unit8* have a bigger size (e.g. uint16) the MSB should be the first byte. [SWS_Crypto_00260] ⌈Each Crypto profile shall define the mapping of the parame- ters of Crypto_CustomService to the using KeyM service/function.⌋ [SWS_Crypto_00262] Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value of the KeyM service ⌈If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for a job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE and if CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be re- turned then secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate return value from Crypto_KeyM_ReturnType data type.⌋ Note: The remaining return values relevant for service CUSTOM_SERVICE map au- tomatically as their enumeration values are identical, i.e. the following Crypto Driver Std_ReturnType values map directly to the according KeyM Std_ReturnType: • E_OK →E_OK • E_NOT_OK →E_NOT_OK • CRYPTO_E_BUSY →KEYM_E_BUSY [SWS_Crypto_00263] Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value of the KeyM_ServiceCertificate ⌈If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for an asyn- chronous job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE that is mapped from a KeyM API that will trigger KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification() and if CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be returned in the Crypto_ResultType param- eter, then uint8* secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate value from Crypto_KeyM_ResultType data type.⌋ [SWS_Crypto_00264] Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value of the KeyM_CertificateVerify ⌈If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for an asyn- chronous job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE that is mapped from a KeyM API that will trigger KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification() and if E_OK or CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be returned in the Crypto_ResultType pa- rameter, then uint8* secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate value from Crypto_KeyM_CertificateStatusType data type.⌋ Note: KeyM distinguishes between KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification() and KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification() callback functions having dif- ferent data types of results, KeyM_ResultType and KeyM_CertificateStatusType. The configured Csm_ApplicationCallbackNotification provides the result as a Crypto_ResultType value. In case of an unrecoverable error, e.g. CRYPTO_E_BUSY, it is not possible to provide a value of KeyM_ResultType or KeyM_CertificateStatusType. Therefore, secondaryOutputPtr will only contain a valid result for KeyM if the Csm_ApplicationCallbackNotification returns E_OK or CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR.
